findings.evidence:
Steps in DOM order:
Confirm your order
,
Enter payment details
,
Choose a plan
. Screen reader linearization: Confirm, Enter, Choose. Visual order via CSS: Choose (order:1), Enter (order:2), Confirm (order:3).
findings.fix: Reorder the step divs in the HTML source to match logical sequence, or use CSS that preserves DOM-reading semantics.
findings.violation: DOM order of wizard steps (Confirm → Enter → Choose) is reversed from visual/logical order (Choose → Enter → Confirm), breaking the meaningful sequence of a checkout flow for screen readers.

findings.evidence: paired with Error.. The error text 'Error.' does not identify the field or the problem.
findings.fix: Replace the generic 'Error.' text with a specific message such as 'Promo code format invalid' or 'This promo code is no longer valid.'
findings.violation: Error message text reads only 'Error.' without naming the field or describing what is wrong with the promo code input marked aria-invalid="true".

findings.evidence: . The div carries no role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or visible text. The img carries no alternative text.
findings.fix: Add role="button" and aria-label="Delete" to the div, or add aria-label directly to the image element.
findings.violation: Custom delete control has no role attribute and no accessible name (no aria-label, aria-labelledby, or text content). The nested trash icon image has empty alt text, providing no name.
